bestBets.overview: On Pace Runners, 1, 6, 10, 12. ZOUS APOLLO was resuming when he stuck to his task in defeat after he became unsuited in transit over 1110m at Port Macquarie. In his case, a switch back to this shorter journey can be regarded as a plus. CERANO MAGIC was spelled after there were excuses for an unplaced Grafton effort at only his second start in his first campaign. He trialed at the end of August with Madeline Owen aboard at his Taree home base and he's now more than ready to make his Tuncurry debut first up. APACHE COMMAND was honest here last start and she will still have scope to improve when she tackles the same trip today. HEART OF JENNI who presents on debut after trialing at Muswellbrook and DYNAMIC DIVA who can be forgiven for an unplaced first up effort here, are both also worthy of consideration.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 5, 8, 11. SEA LEVEL was produced over a shorter journey on debut at Newcastle on the Beaumont track when he clearly suggested that he would already appreciate this awaiting distance rise. SPICY SURPRISE begins his second campaign today after trialing at Muswellbrook and unlike some, he can cope over this journey first up. NORTHY LAD has caused his own problems both at Hawkesbury and then on the Beaumont track at Newcastle when his barrier manners have been an issue. He's trialed at Warwick Farm since and stepping up from 1250m can now be regarded as a plus. FLY THE WIND presents third up and she shouldn't be harshly judged for unplaced efforts since a spell at Gosford or at Newcastle on the Beaumont track last start. She's more suitably placed here over a longer journey today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 5, 6, 8, 10, 14. ANDREA refused to shirk his task in defeat last Saturday at Randwick after he became unsuited in transit. He is already proven after an identical six day break. BROWN SUGAR has bene produced at Canterbury and then on the Beaumont track at Newcastle since a spell. She struck trouble on both occasions before she did enough in both races to be treated with great respect third up today. ROCKIN' MILLIE started at juicy odds after a fifty-four day break when her front-running effort over this trip at Scone was full of merit and this race is now within her reach, ten days later! CAN'T TOUCH THIS presents first up after a recent home based Warwick Farm trial. She finished unplaced first up last campaign at Gosford but her effort was better than it appeared at face value and she shouldn't be underestimated here first up.
